newsitem.title: PERU: All Peru rebels, one hostage, killed - local radio.
newsitem.headline: All Peru rebels, one hostage, killed - local radio.

text.p: All of the Marxist rebels and one hostage were killed after Peruvian soldiers stormed the Japanese ambassador's residence to free the 72 hostages, local radio reported on Tuesday.

Earlier, a local television station said that all hostages were rescued alive. Among the diplomats, military officials and businessmen held hostage were Peru's Foreign Minister Francisco Tudela and Japanese ambassador Morihisa Aoki.
